Actor Shiva Rajkumar Apologizes for Hindi National Language Remark

Actor Shiva Rajkumar has apologized for stating that Hindi is the national language. He made the remark at the "Original Monster" event and subsequently faced backlash. Rajkumar clarified that he became confused during the event and that his statement was not intended to cause offense. He expressed regret for any misunderstanding or hurt caused by his comment.
